meta.pain-targeted: "Quante estati hai passato sotto un pareo?" - libertà persa in vacanza

image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference) at the beach, holding a beach pareo/sarong in front of her body with both hands - she shows it to camera with a direct knowing expression as if saying "we know this one". She wears a simple cream or neutral kaftan or oversized white t-shirt over swimwear (NOT visible body shaming). Behind her: simple Mediterranean beach in midday clear light, sea visible, NOT golden hour cinematic.
Her expression: coach direct, slight raised eyebrow, "I see you, I've been there" energy. NOT melancholy contemplative. NOT sad sunset.
CRITICAL STYLE: PRACTICAL coach Instagram-talking-head energy, clean modern photography, midday natural light NOT golden hour Bertolucci. Real Italian woman 45, real body type, no retouching, no makeup heavy. The pareo is shown as OBJECT she's discussing, not symbolic.
Composition: subject from chest up holding pareo visible in front, beach in background blurred, plenty of clean negative space top/bottom for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic golden hour, sunset Mediterranean, contemplative pose, lounge chair scene, melancholy, sad gaze at horizon, Bertolucci, vintage filter, vacation paradise stock, fashion editorial, model thin, instagram filter, beauty filter, makeup heavy

design-brief.instructions: Layout brand WINNER v5 con foto Elena.
